links.outcome: Missed escalation: critical REFER NOW cases downgraded to TREAT HERE (safety score)
links.effect: All six models achieved 100% safety scores (95% CI 96.4-100.0%); no critical REFER NOW case was downgraded to TREAT HERE.
links.quote: All six models achieved 100% safety scores (95% CI: 96.4-100.0%), never downgrading a critical REFER NOW case to TREAT HERE.

links.outcome: Triage accuracy of guideline-embedded systems versus general-purpose models
links.effect: Clinically engineered systems with embedded WHO guidelines outperformed general-purpose models by up to 28.5 percentage points in triage accuracy.
links.quote: Clinically engineered systems with embedded WHO guidelines outperform general-purpose models by up to 28.5 percentage points.
